blockingIssues.description: executeWorkstream() from model-connector.ts is fundamentally incompatible with the integrate flow. It calls parseModelResponse() which expects '## CHANGES\n```json [{file, action, content}]```' format and then applyChanges() to write files to disk. The integrate prompt asks the AI to return a plain JSON array of test files [{path, content, language, framework, testCount}]. These formats are incompatible, so any real invocation of forge integrate with a configured AI model will fail with AI_GENERATION_FAILED (PARSE_ERROR). Fix: replace executeWorkstream with direct calls to callModel + loadModelConfig from model-connector.ts, then parse the response with parseTestFilesFromAIResponse.
